address: 315 Soi Ongkharak 13, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: Chef Thanintorn 'Noom' Chantharawan's passionate take on traditional Thai cuisine balances domestic with international and classic with contemporary in dishes that use first-rate ingredients from around Thailand. The Thai food in 4 Regions” set, presents a dazzling array of flavours. The setting, a vintage wooden house decorated with abundant greenery, invites you to relax and savour your meal. Booking is a must....
